name: Lycorhinus
sum: A heterodontosaurid known from fragmentary Early Jurassic jaw material from South Africa and Lesotho, first named as a cynodont.
wsnote: Not given in the sources used; the remains may indicate an individual larger than Heterodontosaurus.
holotype: SAM 3606, a partial jaw from Paballong, Mount Fletcher district, South Africa, now only an original canine and an impression of the rest of the jaw and teeth.
material: Lanasaurus scalpridens (a maxilla, BPI 4244, from Golden Gate Highlands National Park) is treated as a junior synonym, and a partial skull from the original locality has been referred to it.
biology: A heterodontosaurid with a large canine-like tusk; the sources consulted do not describe its habits.
author: Haughton 1924
